# Introduction

Purpose of this notebook is preliminary analysis and scratch work for INSPIRE cost-effectiveness project

## Load libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
library(magrittr)
library(rsample)
```


## Constants

```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64
```

```{r}
  inspire.test.zaimara

sim.results.pop.scaling <- inspire.test.results %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

inspire.test.results <- inspire.test.results %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  )
```

# Event counter

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.id) %>% 
  summarize(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor),
            .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = mean(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = mean(PrEP_INSPIRE),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE, PrEP_INSPIRE, OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
           values_to = "Value", 
           names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  filter(scenario_name == 'art') %>% View
```

# Plots

Now that I've established that the interventions are going out, do they have any effect whatsoever?

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  filter(Year > 2015) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor), 
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Infected = mean(Infected), 
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Died_from_HIV, Infected, Newly.Infected, On_ART),
               values_to = "Value", 
               names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name ) ) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(Metric), scales = "free_y")
```


```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year - .5)) %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2025) %>% filter(scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "art")) %>% 
  filter(Age < 25, Age >= 15) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(On_ART = mean(On_ART),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  mutate(rati = OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer/On_ART)
```


# Calculate Metrics

Calculate numbers of deaths and numbers of interventions

```{r}
## All ages
metrics.all.ages <- cbind(
  inspire.test.results %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2046) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
              PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART = mean(Off_ART),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = mean(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
              PrEP_INSPIRE = mean(PrEP_INSPIRE),
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup(),
  inspire.test.results %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2046) %>% 
    filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)
              ) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV.baseline = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected.baseline = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected.baseline = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART.baseline = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART.baseline = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-scenario_name)
)  %>% mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.change = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.change = Infected - Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.change = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.change = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.change = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.change/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.pct = Infected.change/Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.change/Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.pct = On_ART.change/On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.change/Off_ART.baseline
  )

## Adults only

    filter(Age >= 15, Age < 25) %>% 
    filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)
              ) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV.baseline = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected.baseline = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected.baseline = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART.baseline = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART.baseline = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-scenario_name)
)  %>% mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.change = Died_from_HIV- Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.change = Infected - Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.change = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.change = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.change = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.change/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.pct = Infected.change/Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.change/Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.pct = On_ART.change/On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.change/Off_ART.baseline
  )

datestring <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

write_csv(metrics.all.ages,paste0(c("/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/INSPIRE_CE_Prelim_A1599_",datestring,".csv"), collapse = ''))
write_csv(metrics.youth,paste0(c("/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/INSPIRE_CE_Prelim_A1525_",datestring,".csv"), collapse = ''))
```

# Other checks

## Incidence check

Does ZAIMARA actually reduce incidence by 43%, or is it by a different number?


### Incidence reduction in all adults
```{r}
data <- inspire.test.results %>% filter(Age >= 15, scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "zaimara"))

# Calculate incidence
data$Year_Integer <- floor((data$Year-0.5))
# Aggregate number of new infections each year, broken down by Year_Integer and Gender
trajectories_IR.1a <- aggregate(Newly.Infected ~ Year_Integer+Gender + sim.id+scenario_name, data=data,FUN=sum)
#Make the denominator as HIV-negative individuals
trajectories_IR.2 <- aggregate(Population - Infected ~ Year+Gender + sim.id+scenario_name, data=data, FUN=sum)
trajectories_IR.2$Year_Integer <- floor(trajectories_IR.2$Year-0.5)
#remove second instance of duplicate rows
trajectories_IR.2 <- trajectories_IR.2[!duplicated(trajectories_IR.2[c("Year_Integer","Gender", "sim.id","scenario_name")]),]
trajectories_IR.2 <- trajectories_IR.2[-match("Year",names(trajectories_IR.2))]
trajectories_IRoverall <- merge(trajectories_IR.1a, trajectories_IR.2, by=c("Year_Integer","Gender","sim.id","scenario_name"))
trajectories_IRoverall$incidence <- trajectories_IRoverall$Newly.Infected / (trajectories_IRoverall$Population)
data <- trajectories_IRoverall %>% dplyr::rename(Year = Year_Integer)

# Calculate mean incidence across all sim runs
inc.data.mean <- data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean.Incidence = mean(incidence),
                  sd.Incidence = sd(incidence),
            .groups = 'keep') %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(upper = mean.Incidence + 2*sd.Incidence,
                lower = case_when(mean.Incidence - 2 * sd.Incidence > 0 ~ mean.Incidence - 2 * sd.Incidence,
                         mean.Incidence - 2 * sd.Incidence <= 0 ~ 0)
                )

inc.data.mean %>% filter(Year >= 2025) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Year, names_from = scenario_name, values_from = mean.Incidence) %>% 
  mutate(ratio = zaimara/baseline)

# This starts out around 43% but then decreases over time...
```
